pages.text: Tourists walk into town along roads in the morning and leave once their three need bars are full. The management loop revolves around their three need bars.

Tourists have three $(bold)need bars$(): $(bold)Comfort / Magic / Wonder$(). They go to places that fill these bars — shops for goods, service buildings for service, relax buildings to recover energy — filling them one by one.$(br2)Each tourist has a $(bold)profile$(): favoring Comfort, Magic, or Wonder, and prioritizes the bar they favor.
pages.title: Three Need Bars

pages.text: $(bold)Item  Description$()$(li)$(bold)Need bars$() — Comfort / Magic / Wonder — current and required amounts$(li)$(bold)Energy$() — Consumed by interactions; when exhausted, only relax buildings remain$(li)$(bold)Level$() — Wealth level (1~5). Higher means more spending and higher needs$(li)$(bold)Wallet$() — Travel money on hand$(li)$(bold)Stay$() — Nights stayed / total days planned$(li)$(bold)Itinerary$() — Buildings visited and gains per visit (Comfort+X Magic+Y Wonder+Z · Energy+W)
pages.title: The Info Screen (Aim Your Crosshair at a Tourist and Right-Click to Open)

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Arrival$(): walks into town along roads in the morning — $(bold)only on paved roads$().$(li)$(bold)Explore$(): automatically picks the most suitable destination (computed from need gap + energy + wallet — the most lacking bar gets visited first). Buying at shops, services at service buildings, soaking at bathhouses, withdrawing at ATMs.$(li)$(bold)Overnight$(): from nightfall (~19:40) tourists prefer a $(bold)hotel$(); after checking in they remember that hotel, come back to sleep every night and wake with full energy. Tourists still without a hotel head straight to the nearest one in the late evening (~21:00).$(li)$(bold)Departure$(): tourists with $(bold)all three need bars full$() leave happily that night, and the town gains $(bold)experience$(); hotel guests stay until their trip ends (2~4 days); tourists with neither a hotel nor full bars leave late at night (after ~21:00).$(br2)Tourists stay $(bold)2~4 days$() and visit each building only once during the whole stay ($(bold)ATMs are the exception$(): while travel money is still left and the wallet runs low again, they can go back for another withdrawal after a short cooldown — money comes out in batches).
pages.title: A Tourist's Day

pages.text: $(bold)Type  Function$()$(li)$(bold)Relax buildings$() (bathhouses etc.) — Restore energy; visited by tourists whose energy is out but who won't leave$(li)$(bold)ATM buildings$() (ATMs) — Refill the wallet; visited by tourists out of travel money but unfinished$(li)$(bold)Hotel$() — Sleep overnight to restore energy — see the $(l:wandscape:building/hotel_guide)Hotel Guide$(/l)$(br2)With all three in place, tourists can fill their need bars in town before leaving.
pages.title: Three Support Buildings

pages.text: $(bold)Item  Description$()$(li)Capacity — Set by the building's number of $(bold)interact spots$()$(li)Queue — When all spots are full, later arrivals queue; those who wait too long leave$(li)Expand — Add more interact spots, or build more buildings of the same type
pages.title: Queues & Capacity

pages.text: About $(bold)5% of tourists are wizard tourists$(). Wizard tourists with all three need bars full leave resumes at the $(l:wandscape:building/tavern_guide)Tavern$(/l) and can be recruited $(bold)for free$().
pages.title: Wizard Tourists

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Roads paved and buildings built$(): a bit of everything — shops, service, relax, ATM — gives tourists places to go.$(li)$(bold)Values on target$(): the Comfort/Magic/Wonder values a building carries decide which need bar it feeds and how fast.$(li)$(bold)Enough spots and roads$(): smooth travel raises the share of tourists leaving with all bars full.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/shop_guide)Shop$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/hotel_guide)Hotel & Service Buildings$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:building/tavern_guide)Tavern$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:contents/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
